expression.label: Expression (Query Articulation Gap)
expression.description: User cannot articulate partial memories (approximate date, emotional moment, visual detail) into a searchable text query.

sample_quotes.quote: Before a week ago I could type in a search for a photo and the relevant photos would be shown. Now I get completely unrelated images.

interpretation.label: Interpretation (Semantic & Intent Failure)
interpretation.description: Search engine fails to parse relative dates, entities, or compositional criteria, or Ask Photos hallucinates/returns clutter.

sample_quotes.quote: the search queries that once brought the exact results I was looking for , now return a jumbled mess of unrelated files.

recovery.label: Recovery (Refinement Dead-Ends & Timeline Fallback)
recovery.description: Search fails and offers no interactive refinement; retries start cold, forcing the user into exhaustive manual scrolling.

sample_quotes.quote: Search gave zero results so I spent 40 minutes scrolling through years of photos to find it manually.

evaluation.label: Evaluation (Disambiguation & Context Overload)
evaluation.description: Results return too many identical or ungrounded photos without contextual metadata, making it impossible to identify the target memory.

sample_quotes.quote: cannot scroll down search results it just keeps jumping back to the top.

subcategories.label: Vague Memory Cue
subcategories.sample_quote: Before a week ago I could type in a search for a photo and the relevant photos would be shown. Now I can type in exactly the same search and thousands appear, the vast majority of no relevance.

subcategories.label: Literal Keyword Match
subcategories.sample_quote: the search queries that once brought the exact results I was looking for , now return a jumbled mess of unrelated files.

subcategories.label: Query Formulation Gap
subcategories.sample_quote: Plus figuring out how to word intuitive thought into what AI needs to find photos & still receive less accurate results. You can switch Classic and Gemini but, even Classic is affected.

subcategories.label: Forced Scroll Or Abandon
subcategories.sample_quote: Search gave zero results so I spent 40 minutes scrolling through years of photos to find it manually.

subcategories.label: Zero Recall Miss
subcategories.sample_quote: Half of my date searches now return zero results unless I use very specific (unintuitive) date formats. Photos repeat when scrolling search results.

subcategories.label: Scrolling Friction
subcategories.sample_quote: cannot scroll down search results it just keeps jumping back to the top.
